# Path rules of the CI area classifier (.github/scripts/ci_changes.py).
# One rule per line: <area> <pattern>. Patterns are fnmatch patterns on the
# repository path, where * also matches /. A code path no rule names is
# "shared". The first matching rule wins.

j1939 test/fixtures/config/cases-j1939.json
j1939 examples/j1939/*
